mechanism: Armodafinil may increase chloroquine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and competition for hepatic metabolism, while chloroquine may enhance CNS stimulation effects of armodafinil.
action: Monitor for increased chloroquine toxicity (visual disturbances, arrhythmias) and armodafinil adverse effects (insomnia, headache, tachycardia); consider dose adjustment of chloroquine if necessary.
